question: A is the mother of C who is not the son. C has a daughter E. A is married to F. F has a son B who has a son D. What is the relation of D and E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) A is the mother of C who is not the son. 

2) A is married to F.C has a daughter E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/435995074bc545d0599629b009e3a6166df1424dd14fa1c33861b5ebc55e8cfa.png] 

3) C has a daughter E.

4) F has a son B who has a son D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9bc28948870ada0b08217e2cf2ce9225383a87029edfb174665e971aa3a681b.png] 

Thus, D is E's cousin.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
